verdict.rationale: DBOS queues let you run many workflows at once with managed concurrency and flow control, so you can fan work out across many items. Conductor's HTTP API and the dbosctl CLI expose workflow search, cancel and fork, which can be scripted to act on many workflows. However, no first-class bulk or batch action (e.g., cancel or resume all matching workflows in one call) is documented; bulk management must be scripted on top of per-workflow operations. Missing for 10: an explicit documented bulk/batch operation API or CLI command, examples of acting on many workflows in one call, and independent or hands-on corroboration of bulk workflows.
